title: What the knots read in SEED's second phase
objective: KNOT-SWITCH-20261118-001's first direction, chosen by the coordinator: after its switch SEED takes only fills that copy or conserve crossings, which keeps two orders. Can a reading of the knots near a move, rather than of crossings, tell the fills that keep two orders from those that raise them? Tiers: the move's own knots; presented knots within one and two steps; and the betweenness the states imply among the move's old distinctions. Along SEED with knot-local moves from every bracketing of 5 to 8. Serves G1 and G16; challenges A101.
stop_rule: One proof and one frozen computation with its read-out; referee hand-off; report.
